name: AttachmentViewer
label: Attachment viewer
description: A preview dialog for a message's files, with download, stepping, and plain states for files it cannot show.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the viewer is open.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Fires when the viewer asks to close: the close button, Escape, or the backdrop.

props.name: items
props.description: The files the viewer steps through, in order.

props.name: activeId
props.description: Id of the file on show, for controlled use. Pair with `onActiveChange`.

props.name: defaultActiveId
props.description: Id of the file shown first, for uncontrolled use. Defaults to the first item.

props.name: onActiveChange
props.description: Fires with the id of the file stepped to.

props.name: renderPreview
props.description:
Draws a file the viewer cannot: the pages of a PDF, a media player, a
rendered spreadsheet. Return nothing to fall back to the built-in view.

props.name: onDownload
props.description: Fires with the file on show when Download is pressed. Its presence renders the buttons.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Fires with a file that failed to load when "Try again" is pressed. Its presence renders the button.

props.name: dismissible
props.description: Whether Escape, the backdrop and the close button dismiss the viewer.

props.name: downloadLabel
props.description: Text of the Download buttons.

props.name: closeLabel
props.description: Accessible label for the close button.

props.name: previousLabel
props.description: Accessible label for the previous-file button.

props.name: nextLabel
props.description: Accessible label for the next-file button.

props.name: retryLabel
props.description: Text of the retry button.

props.name: noPreviewLabel
props.description: Headline when a file has nothing the viewer can draw.
props.default: No preview for this file type

props.name: failedLabel
props.description: Headline when a file failed to load or is no longer available.

props.name: failedDescription
props.description: Sentence under `failedLabel`, when the file carries no error message of its own.

props.name: formatPosition
props.description: Builds the position text, e.g. "2 of 5", from a one-based index and the total.

props.name: locale
props.description: The BCP 47 locale file sizes are written in, such as `de-DE` (`1,5 MB`). Defaults to the nearest LocaleProvider's, else `en-US`.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes — applied to the portal container, not the panel.

AttachmentItem.description:
One attachment as the family passes it around: what a tile draws, what a
group lays out, and what `useAttachments` keeps. Plain data, so it
serialises and crosses the server boundary; the `File` itself stays with
whoever owns the upload.

AttachmentStatus.description: Where an attachment is in its life: usable, on its way, failed, or gone.
